input.prompt:
3D Pixar-style animated film, vertical 9:16, cinematic golden-hour light shafts, shallow depth of field, rich detail. Characters, keep them exactly as in the reference images in every shot, never stretching or changing proportions: the small green frog Fizz (image 1) with sly half-closed amber eyes, the caramel bunny (image 2) with one floppy ear and a green scarf, the chubby brown beaver Bucky (image 3) with two big front teeth, and small cute fuzzy bees (image 4). Setting: the forest clearing with the giant tree, the dripping golden beehive and the pond (image 5). A comedic 15-second story in 4 cinematic shots with hard cuts, every shot starts with immediate action.
Shot 1 (0-4s): low-angle wide shot under the giant tree: Bucky stands at the bottom, the bunny stands on his shoulders, and Fizz balances on top of the bunny's head, the three-high tower wobbling comically as they stretch toward the dripping honeycomb above; a few bees buzz lazily around the hive; the tower creaks and sways.
Shot 2 (4-7s): close-up on Fizz at the top: he dips his finger into the dripping honey, tastes it and his eyes roll back in bliss, a long honey string stretching from his finger; behind him the hive shakes and cracks open and a huge swarm of bees pours out with an angry buzz.
Shot 3 (7-11s): tracking shot at running height: the tower collapses into a tumble of limbs and the three friends sprint away through the forest in panic, Bucky's heavy feet thumping on the ground, the bunny bouncing, Fizz leaping, the bee swarm chasing close behind in a dark buzzing cloud, branches and leaves whipping past.
Shot 4 (11-15s): wide shot at the pond: they leap into the water with a huge splash, then three heads pop up, honey still stuck on Fizz's mouth, bees circling above the water and one bee landing on Bucky's nose; Fizz grins sheepishly at the camera.
Sound design only, absolutely no music, loud dense layered sound: forest ambience and birds, creaking wobbling tower, honey drip and sticky stretch, an angry rising bee-swarm buzz, thumping footsteps, panicked squeaks and gasps, a big water splash, and small comic boing accents synced to the motion.
